```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`DSEMr` provides a clean-room compatibility parser for Mplus Version 8 and
Version 9 DSEM specifications, translating `VARIABLE`, `DEFINE`, `ANALYSIS`,
and `MODEL` sections into the exact same canonical intermediate representation
as `lavaan`-extended DSEM syntax.

Supported Mplus constructs include:

- `TYPE = TWOLEVEL RANDOM`, `TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM` (Version 9 DSEM3), and
  `TYPE = CROSSCLASSIFIED RANDOM`
- `TINTERVAL = time(delta)`, `LAGGED = y(1)`, `CATEGORICAL = u1-u4`
- `DEFINE: CENTER x (GROUPMEAN | GRANDMEAN);`
- Named random slopes (`s | y ON y&1;`), random log residual variances
  (`logv | y;`), residual dynamics (`y^ ON y^1;`), dynamic CFA/IRT (`BY` with
  `(&1)`, `*`, `@value`, and cross-level equality `(1-4)`), and `PRIOR = PSEM`

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

lavaan_model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time")
mplus_model <- mplus_to_dsem("
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
    y ON y&1;
", time = "time")
identical(lavaan_model$terms, mplus_model$terms)

# Mplus Version 9 three-level DSEM compilation
m3 <- mplus_to_dsem("
  VARIABLE: CLUSTER = clinic patient;
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = THREELEVEL RANDOM; ESTIMATOR = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
    s | y ON y&1;
    logv | y;
    %BETWEEN patient%
    y;
    %BETWEEN clinic%
    y s logv WITH y s logv;
", time = "occasion")
print(m3)
```
